2607.11399.title: Agentic Routing: The Harness-Native Data Flywheel
2607.11399.paper_summary: Large language model agents are increasingly executed not by a single model call, but by an execution harness that manages observation, context, control, action, state, and verification. At the same time, frontier and open models are becoming structurally specialized: a model that is strong at code editing, long-context recovery, tool use, mathematical reasoning, or low-latency response may not dominate on the other axes. This makes model selection inside an agent a core systems problem rather than a per-query serving trick. Existing routing methods mostly optimize single-turn cost-quality trade-offs and therefore miss the execution state, intermediate failures, and feedback loops that make agents different from chat completion. We propose Harness-Native agentic routing, a step-level routing paradigm that selects either a single best-fit model for cost-effective execution or multiple complementary models for ensemble-style accuracy improvement, conditioned on the full harness state. The key insight is that every routing decision naturally produces a structured data record -- consisting of the query, harness state, model choice or model set, execution trace, outcome, and cost -- whose labels are supplied by the environment rather than by the router itself. These records form a harness-native data flywheel: execution traces train better routers and harness-native models, which improve cost-quality trade-offs and generate more traces under the same budget. We instantiate this idea in OpenSquilla with a four-layer routing stack, an open LightGBM cold-start ranker, and a staged router-model path that turns logged arena records into progressively stronger routing policies. The report studies singleton and multi-model routing on agentic benchmarks including DRACO and PinchBench, and argues that agentic routing is not merely cost control, but a data engine for agent-native training.
2607.11399.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理的執行越來越不是透過單一模型呼叫，而是透過一個執行工具來管理觀察、上下文、控制、行動、狀態和驗證。<lb/>同時，前沿和開放模型在結構上變得越來越專門化：一個在代碼編輯、長上下文恢復、工具使用、數學推理或低延遲響應方面強大的模型，可能在其他方面並不佔優。<lb/>這使得在代理內部的模型選擇成為一個核心系統問題，而不是每次查詢的服務技巧。<lb/>現有的路由方法大多優化單輪成本-質量權衡，因此忽略了執行狀態、中間失敗和反饋循環，這些使得代理與聊天完成有所不同。<lb/>我們提出了Harness-Native代理路由，一種步驟級路由範式，根據完整的執行工具狀態選擇單一最佳模型以實現成本效益的執行，或選擇多個互補模型以提高集成風格的準確性。<lb/>關鍵見解是，每個路由決策自然產生一個結構化數據記錄——包括查詢、執行工具狀態、模型選擇或模型集、執行追蹤、結果和成本——這些標籤由環境提供，而不是由路由器本身提供。<lb/>這些記錄形成一個執行工具原生數據飛輪：執行追蹤訓練更好的路由器和執行工具原生模型，這些模型改善成本-質量權衡，並在相同預算下生成更多追蹤。<lb/>我們在OpenSquilla中實現了這一想法，使用四層路由堆疊、一個開放的LightGBM冷啟動排名器，以及一個分階段的路由器-模型路徑，將登錄的競技場記錄轉化為逐步強化的路由策略。<lb/>該報告研究了在代理基準（包括DRACO和PinchBench）上的單模型和多模型路由，並主張代理路由不僅僅是成本控制，而是代理原生訓練的數據引擎。
